subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should this lineage path remain a dormant legacy-default foundation, become an explicitly opt-in accounting authority after proof, or be deferred until maintainers are ready to define a permanent replacement policy?
rationale: Tests can establish mechanics, but they cannot decide the user-facing compatibility contract or when a materially different source of usage totals is acceptable for existing installations.

options.title: Land dormant and prove rollout
options.body: Merge the stack in order with legacy authoritative, require exact-head upgrade proof, and treat later lineage activation as a separate maintainer-approved change.

options.title: Approve opt-in authority now
options.body: Accept an internal or explicit opt-in lineage authority after the requested proof while preserving legacy rollback and isolated caches.

options.title: Keep shadow-only
options.body: Decline authority promotion for now and retain only non-authoritative shadow diagnostics until more real affected-account evidence accumulates.

recommendation.title: Land dormant and prove rollout
recommendation.body: Merge the stack in order with legacy authoritative, require exact-head upgrade proof, and treat later lineage activation as a separate maintainer-approved change.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is best positioned to set the compatibility and release policy for a new accounting authority.
